<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">CanNegate</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>Set to true if we can negate the whole sub-tree just by changing the conditions on the SETCC tests. (this means we can call <a href="#a588e5dcf7ccf9ec2b6922f24c012a08a">emitConjunctionRec()</a> with Negate==true on this sub-tree)</p></td>

<p>can be transformed to: not (and (not (and (setCC (cmp C)) (setCD (cmp D)))) (and (not (setCA (cmp A)) (not (setCB (cmp B))))))" which can be implemented as: cmp C ccmp D, inv(CD), CC ccmp A, CA, inv(CD) ccmp B, CB, inv(CA) check for CB flags</p>


<p>A counterexample is "or (and A B) (and C D)" which translates to not (and (not (and (not A) (not B))) (not (and (not C) (not D)))), we can only implement 1 of the inner (not) operations, but not both! Create a conditional comparison; <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/use">Use</a> CCMP, CCMN or FCCMP as appropriate.</p>

<p>If the operand is a bitwise AND with a constant RHS, and the shift has a constant RHS and is the only use, we can pull it out of the shift, i.e.</p>


<p>(shl (and X, C1), C2) -&gt; (and (shl X, C2), (shl C1, C2))</p>


<p>We prefer this canonical form to match existing isel patterns.</p>

### replaceSplatVectorStore() {#a824cd060277e4cb924783db572374c66}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">SDValue replaceSplatVectorStore (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/selectiondag">SelectionDAG</a> &amp; DAG, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/storesdnode">StoreSDNode</a> &amp; St)</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsRight">
<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel static">static</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Replace a splat of a scalar to a vector store by scalar stores of the scalar value.</p>


<p>The load store optimizer pass will merge them to store pair stores. This has better performance than a splat of the scalar followed by a split vector store. Even if the stores are not merged it is four stores vs a dup, followed by an ext.b and two stores.</p>

<p>Replace a splat of zeros to a vector store by scalar stores of WZR/XZR.</p>


<p>The load store optimizer pass will merge them to store pair stores. This should be better than a movi to create the vector zero followed by a vector store if the zero constant is not re-used, since one instructions and one register live range will be removed.</p>


<p>For example, the final generated code should be:</p>


<p>stp xzr, xzr, [x0]</p>


<p>instead of:</p>


<p>movi v0.2d, #0 str q0, [x0]</p>

<p>A custom combine to lower load &lt;3 x i8&gt; as the more efficient sequence below: ldrb wX, [x0, #2] ldrh wY, [x0] orr wX, wY, wX, lsl #16 fmov s0, wX</p>


<p>Note that an alternative sequence with even fewer (although usually more complex/expensive) instructions would be: ld1r.4h { v0 }, [x0], #2 ld1.b { v0 }[2], [x0]</p>

<p>static <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/evt">EVT</a> tryGetOriginalBoolVectorType(<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#ab471937b9a227e70c7fe8bd9604014d6">Op</a>, int Depth = 0) { <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/evt">EVT</a> VecVT = Op.getValueType(); assert(VecVT.isVector() &amp;&amp; VecVT.getVectorElementType() == MVT::i1 &amp;&amp; "Need boolean vector type.");</p>

<p>When converting a &lt;N x iX&gt; vector to &lt;N x i1&gt; to store or use as a scalar iN, we can use a trick that extracts the i^th bit from the i^th element and then performs a vector add to get a scalar bitmask. This requires that each element's bits are either all 1 or all 0. static <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> vectorToScalarBitmask(SDNode *N, SelectionDAG &amp;DAG) { <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdloc">SDLoc</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/arm/armslshardening-cpp/#ad467c4ab9119043f9b7750ab986be61a">DL(N)</a>; <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> ComparisonResult(N, 0); <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/evt">EVT</a> VecVT = ComparisonResult.getValueType(); assert(VecVT.isVector() &amp;&amp; "Must be a vector type");</p>


<p>unsigned NumElts = VecVT.getVectorNumElements(); if (NumElts != 2 &amp;&amp; NumElts != 4 &amp;&amp; NumElts != 8 &amp;&amp; NumElts != 16) return <a href="#a51cb24bd3e700fcf2f93d1afbb555a16">SDValue()</a>;</p>


<p>if (VecVT.getVectorElementType() != MVT::i1 &amp;&amp; !DAG.getTargetLoweringInfo().isTypeLegal(VecVT)) return <a href="#a51cb24bd3e700fcf2f93d1afbb555a16">SDValue()</a>;</p>


<p>If we can find the original types to work on instead of a vector of i1, we can avoid extend/extract conversion instructions. if (VecVT.getVectorElementType() == MVT::i1) { VecVT = tryGetOriginalBoolVectorType(ComparisonResult); if (!VecVT.<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/vectorize/slpvectorizer-cpp/#a3ca9742688618517cc4690fb947fb609">isSimple()</a>) { unsigned BitsPerElement = std::max(64 / NumElts, 8u); // &gt;= 64-bit vector VecVT = MVT::getVectorVT(MVT::getIntegerVT(BitsPerElement), NumElts); } } VecVT = VecVT.changeVectorElementTypeToInteger();</p>


<p>Large vectors don't map directly to this conversion, so to avoid too many edge cases, we don't apply it here. The conversion will likely still be applied later via multiple smaller vectors, whose results are concatenated. if (VecVT.getSizeInBits() &gt; 128) return <a href="#a51cb24bd3e700fcf2f93d1afbb555a16">SDValue()</a>;</p>


<p>Ensure that all elements' bits are either 0s or 1s. ComparisonResult = DAG.getSExtOrTrunc(ComparisonResult, DL, VecVT);</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/smallvector">SmallVector&lt;SDValue, 16&gt;</a> MaskConstants; if (DAG.getSubtarget&lt;AArch64Subtarget&gt;().isNeonAvailable() &amp;&amp; VecVT == MVT::v16i8) { v16i8 is a special case, as we have 16 entries but only 8 positional bits per entry. We split it into two halves, apply the mask, zip the halves to create 8x 16-bit values, and the perform the vector reduce. for (unsigned Half = 0; Half &lt; 2; ++Half) { for (unsigned MaskBit = 1; MaskBit &lt;= 128; MaskBit *= 2) { MaskConstants.push_back(DAG.getConstant(MaskBit, DL, MVT::i32)); } } <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> Mask = DAG.getNode(ISD::BUILD_VECTOR, DL, VecVT, MaskConstants); <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> RepresentativeBits = DAG.getNode(ISD::AND, DL, VecVT, ComparisonResult, Mask);</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> UpperRepresentativeBits = DAG.getNode(<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/aarch64isd/#a35ad1b8db0dfad0b69c9185c5fe24e19a489b5bf6d9df2ae4dac6fce059b91bda">AArch64ISD::EXT</a>, DL, VecVT, RepresentativeBits, RepresentativeBits, DAG.getConstant(8, DL, MVT::i32)); <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> Zipped = DAG.getNode(AArch64ISD::ZIP1, DL, VecVT,
                                 RepresentativeBits, UpperRepresentativeBits); Zipped = DAG.getNode(ISD::BITCAST, DL, MVT::v8i16, Zipped); return DAG.getNode(ISD::VECREDUCE_ADD, DL, MVT::i16, Zipped); }</p>


<p>All other vector sizes. unsigned MaxBitMask = 1u &lt;&lt; (VecVT.getVectorNumElements() - 1); for (unsigned MaskBit = 1; MaskBit &lt;= MaxBitMask; MaskBit *= 2) { MaskConstants.push_back(DAG.getConstant(MaskBit, DL, MVT::i64)); }</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> Mask = DAG.getNode(ISD::BUILD_VECTOR, DL, VecVT, MaskConstants); <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> RepresentativeBits = DAG.getNode(ISD::AND, DL, VecVT, ComparisonResult, Mask); <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/evt">EVT</a> ResultVT = <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mvt/#aded931e298cfa08b5038ca2b63c06bb8">MVT::getIntegerVT</a>(std::max&lt;unsigned&gt;( NumElts, VecVT.getVectorElementType().getSizeInBits())); return DAG.getNode(ISD::VECREDUCE_ADD, DL, ResultVT, RepresentativeBits); }</p>

<p>static <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sdvalue">SDValue</a> performMSTORECombine(SDNode *N,
